name: Creme 4 Fun
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR(MAIDA), SUGAR, REFINED PALM OIL, INVERT SYRUP, I0DIZED SALT, RAISING AGENTS [503(ii), 500(ii)], EMULSIFIERS (322, 471), STARCH, DOUGH CONDITIONER (223), HJMECTANT (422) AND STRAWBERRY FRUIT POWDER(0.002%). CONTAINS PERMITTED SYNTHETIC FOOD COLOUR(127) AND ADDED FLAVOURS (ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES - VANILLA, STRAWBERRY). (Numbers in brackets as per International Numbering System.), ALLERGEN: Contains Wheat, Soya & Sulphites. May Contain Traces of Milk & Tree Nuts.
